title: orchestration-state
description: Durable JSON state contract for /prp-orchestrate. Persisted as JSON (not markdown prose) because models overwrite prose but respect structured JSON (KB: Harness Patterns F03). The mediator is the single writer; specialists read it. Stored in the Obsidian vault via the ultimate-obsidian MCP as a single fenced ```json block inside 02-Notes/Sessions/{TICKET}-{SUFFIX}.state.md, the sidecar to the run's session note. NEVER written to the repo: a repo-local file is invisible to sibling worktrees, to the next session, and dies with the checkout. Writes are always a whole-note overwrite of one full instance — never an append, never a partial patch. A failed vault write is a blocker; there is no local fallback.

preset.description: Active preset name binding generic roles to repos/stacks (e.g. 'seathq'), or 'none' for generic single-repo mode.

baseBranch.description: Detected base branch that every specialist worktree forks from.

capability.description: Capability preflight result (U-1/U-2). Drives parallel-vs-serial fallback.

agentTeamsEnabled.description: Whether env CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is set (confirmed enable key, official docs).

teamToolsAvailable.description: Whether SendMessage + natural-language teammate spawn are exposed in this build.

mode.description: parallel = worktree-per-specialist fan-out; serial = one-writer-at-a-time worktree fallback.

analyze.description: Phase 0.5 — the spec-analyze cross-artifact gate, run in a fresh context BEFORE any worktree exists. CRITICAL > 0 blocks fan-out.

attempt.description: analyze→fix→re-analyze cycle. After 3 the run stops and escalates to the human.

coveragePct.description: Requirements (FR + buildable SC + scenarios) with ≥1 task, as a percentage.

metrics.description: requirements, buildableSC, tasks, unmappedTasks, ambiguities, duplicates, criticals, territoryOverlaps.

routedTo.description: Owning phase: refinement | prp-plan | project-manager | contract-freeze.

contracts.description: Phase A2 — the frozen cross-lane interface set. Published on the base branch with FAILING contract tests before any lane forks. Immutable for the slice: a lane editing one of these files is a 🔴 routed to project-manager as an amendment request.

path.description: File that declares the interface (shared type, endpoint schema, migration, event payload).

consumes.description: Roles that depend on it. An empty list is a speculative interface — drop it (G-SIMPLICITY).

test.description: Contract test command. MUST fail against the pre-change code at freeze time.

failedAtFreeze.description: Confirmation that the contract test failed before implementation existed. A contract test green at freeze proves nothing.

frozenAt.description: SHA on the base branch where the contract landed.

slices.description: Vertical increments: S0 = Foundational (blocking shared groundwork, kept as small as possible), then one slice per user story in priority order. Each ends in a demoable checkpoint. Territories are disjoint WITHIN a slice; different slices may touch the same file because they are separated in time.

story.description: Story id from spec.md, e.g. 'US1'. Absent for the foundational slice.

priority.description: P1, P2, … — the order slices run in.

independentTest.description: How this slice is verified ALONE. It is the checkpoint criterion; a slice whose Independent Test fails is not a checkpoint whatever its unit gates say.

stackLayer.description: Present only when stack.enabled. This slice's layer in the GitHub stack: its own named branch, its PR, and the layer below it. Layer order MUST equal slice priority order — GitHub stacks are linear and merge bottom-up.

branch.description: Named, pushed branch holding this slice's merged lanes, e.g. 'stack/<slug>/s1-<story-slug>'. Not a throwaway sha on a shared integration branch — the stack layer IS this branch.

position.description: 0 = bottom layer (targets trunk). Each subsequent layer targets the branch of position-1.

baseBranch.description: What this layer's PR targets: the trunk for position 0, otherwise the position-1 layer's branch.

prNumber.description: PR number created by 'gh stack submit'. Absent until submission.

gateReceiptSha.description: pre-pr-gate receipt bound to this layer's tip. Every layer carries its own receipt — branch protection and required checks are enforced per layer, so one receipt for the whole stack is not sufficient.

territoryDisjoint.description: Set-intersection check over the union of each lane's task files:. False ⇒ ABORT allocation for this slice.

sha.description: Integration SHA the next slice's worktrees fork from.

demoable.description: If the run stopped here, what is on the branch works and is worth having.

gateReceiptSha.description: pre-pr-gate receipt bound to this checkpoint, when the gate ran here.

convergence.description: Phase E3 — spec-converge reconciliation of the gated branch against spec.md. Append-only; unrequested code is surfaced, never deleted.

pass.description: Converge pass number. Each pass must find strictly fewer findings than the last; ≤3 passes.

sourceRef.description: FR-###, SC-###, US1/AC2, or a constitution principle id.

appendedTask.description: Task id appended to the Convergence phase of tasks.md.

contract.description: Granular, testable 'done' criteria negotiated on disk BEFORE any code is written (KB: Harness Patterns F05). Each maps to ≥1 FR / buildable SC / acceptance scenario of the spec.

gate.description: Executable predicate (shell command) that proves the criterion — never an adjective.

acRef.description: Which requirement this criterion serves: FR-###, SC-###, or US#/AC#.

sliceId.description: Slice this criterion belongs to (S0, S1, …).

files.description: Exact files this criterion's tasks write. The union per lane IS the territory — derived, not hand-drawn, which is what makes disjointness provable.

parallel.description: [P] — safe to run concurrently with other [P] criteria in the same lane (no shared file, no dependency).

specialists.description: Active specialists in the CURRENT slice (mediator enforces 2-5, never all 7 — KB: Agent Teams P04/X04). Per-slice history lives in slices[].specialists.

boundRepo.description: Repo/path the preset binds this role to (e.g. 'seathq-fe'), or 'self' for single-repo.

worktree.description: Absolute path of THIS specialist's git worktree — distinct per active specialist (AC-4).

territory.description: Glob patterns this specialist exclusively owns. MUST be pairwise-disjoint with every other active specialist's territory (AC-4 invariant).

recipients.description: Named message recipients (KB: Agent Teams P03 — name recipients explicitly). e.g. frontend -> [qa-analyst, ux-specialist].

rounds.description: One entry per mediator round; each carries the per-specialist verdicts graded against the target repo's .claude/ rules.

verdict.description: ✅ on-track / ⚠️ drift-risk / 🔴 drifting. 🔴 (MUST or MUST-NOT violation, or drift-guard 3+ fails) BLOCKS this specialist's merge.

ruleViolations.description: Specific rules violated, severity-tagged. A ratified-constitution MUST violation and a frozen-contract edit are 🔴 regardless of what the style rulebook says.

source.description: Which authority the violation comes from. Defaults to repo-rules.

actionableCriteria.description: On a failing verdict, the concrete fix criteria returned to the specialist (KB: adversarial evaluator returns a rubric, not vibes).

mergeLog.description: Serial merge record — worktrees merged one at a time, passing verdicts only (AC-4).

integrationGate.description: Phase E2 — one entry per repo with diffs, recording the pre-pr-gate run on the MERGED HEAD. A PR may not be opened unless every entry has verdict 'pass' with a receiptSha equal to that repo's current HEAD. Populated by the mediator from each gate receipt (skills/pre-pr-gate/references/gate-receipt.schema.json).

receiptSha.description: HEAD SHA the gate ran against. A receipt whose sha != current HEAD is stale and counts as absent.

attempt.description: Fix/re-gate cycle. After 3 the run stops and escalates to the human.

blockers.description: Surviving 🔴 findings, each routed to the owning territory as next-round actionable criteria.

ruleId.description: Repo rule ID for bot-parity findings (e.g. FR-2, DB-3, CORE-002).

routedTo.description: Role given the fix, or 'project-manager' when the blocker crosses two territories (a contract/territory-map bug, not a specialist error).

receiptBlock.description: Rendered receipt block, pasted verbatim into the PR description.

territoryDisjoint.description: AC-4 invariant assertion: true iff every pair of active specialists' territory globs is disjoint. The mediator MUST abort allocation (Phase B) if this is false.

stack.description: Phase A3 — whether this run ships as a GitHub stacked-PR chain (one PR per slice) instead of one PR for the whole run. Opt-in: --stack, or the user accepting the post-decomposition offer. Absent or enabled=false ⇒ the existing single-PR behaviour, unchanged.

decidedBy.description: 'unavailable' = gh or the gh-stack extension is missing, or the run is on a fork; the flow falls back to a single PR and says so.

extensionAvailable.description: Result of 'gh stack --help'. Absent extension is a fallback trigger, never a hard failure.

repo.description: Repo this stack belongs to. Stacks cannot span repositories — a multi-repo run produces one independent stack per repo, and stacks[] is recorded per repo.

trunk.description: Branch the bottom layer targets — the detected base, or --base.

branchPrefix.description: e.g. 'stack/<slug>/'. Every layer branch lives under it.

layerOrder.description: Slice ids bottom-to-top. MUST be linear and MUST match slice priority order; a non-linear (DAG) slice dependency cannot be represented as a stack and forces enabled=false.

submitted.description: True once 'gh stack submit' has created/updated every layer's PR.

verifiedBy.description: Verbatim 'gh stack view --json' output (or its path) confirming the on-GitHub topology matches layerOrder. Submission is not complete until this agrees.

humanGates.description: The only points the run stopped for a human (AC-1): requirement fork or red blast-radius (auth/payments/deploy/db-migration).
